messages:
andrea: Nightly e2e job failed perf gate — p95 +18% vs baseline on longseq. job: nightly-e2e-longseq #3452. stack: runtime/master. Suspect batching change or infra noise. Anyone available to rerun and grab traces? CI: https://ci.internal/runs/3452 :eyes:
ci-bot: Automated failure notice — test=e2e-longseq metric=p95_latency threshold=12ms observed=14.2ms. artifacts -> s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/3452
sam: on it, queueing a rerun now.
infra-bot: Rerun requested by @sam for run 3452 -> new run id 3453 (queued on us-west2).
micah: FYI I landed a microbatch packing tweak yesterday (sha abc1234). Could affect seq packing; I can revert if rerun reproduces.
lina: was that run in us-west2? any node pool maintenance scheduled?
andrea: nope, no maintenance. control plane looks healthy, node pool stable per console.
sam: rerun 3453 started. watching p95 and p50.
sam: rerun 3453 finished — p95=12.1ms, p50=3.2ms. within tolerance. looks transient.
micah: good to hear. prefer to avoid revert for now. mark flaky unless we see a pattern.
jules: +1. can we add a tiny perf smoke for PRs that touch the batcher so we catch this earlier?
andrea: yes — add a short longseq presubmit check for batcher changes. micah can you do that?
micah: will do. i'll add a small presubmit job that runs a minimal longseq sample and posts p95. filing PR now.
lina: also request: extend trace retention for this run to 48h in case it reappears.
infra-bot: Trace retention updated for run 3453 -> 48h by automation.
andrea: thanks everyone — marking this resolved. :white_check_mark:
_metadata_note: This document is a single Slack thread representing a quick CI perf gate failure, rerun, and coordination. Messages are chronological and kept concise.
